text: What Holmes tells in the weighing enclosure
why: Holmes speaks in the weighing enclosure and promises to tell everything.
Holmes names spirits of wine as what will wash the horse's face and leg.
The bay has no white hair, yet washing its face and leg will reveal Silver Blaze, so it is plainly disguised.

text: Race day: in the weighing enclosure, after the race
why: After the race, the party goes into the weighing enclosure on race day.
